review.assessment: The provided change creates solution.sh but leaves the exact off-by-one bug described in the task intact. Because the loop condition relies solely on `while read -r line`, Bash returns a non-zero exit status when EOF is reached without a trailing newline, causing the final unterminated line to never enter the loop body. The script will therefore undercount by one for any input stream that lacks a terminating newline.

findings.defect: Still misses the last line when input lacks a trailing newline.
